strings.ui_cast_hint_connected: Connected — choose a video, song, or photo on your phone
strings.ui_cast_takeover_heading: Another device wants to take over
strings.ui_cast_takeover_description: Allowing it will end the current cast and switch to the new one.
strings.ui_cast_takeover_timeout: If you do not choose in time, the current cast will continue.
strings.ui_cast_hint_idle: Cast content from your phone to this device
strings.ui_cast_hint_step1: ① Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi network as this device
strings.ui_cast_hint_step2: ② Tap Cast or Mirror in your phone's gallery or video app
strings.ui_cast_hint_step3: ③ Select this device from the device list
strings.ui_cast_hint_apps: Works with apps that support DLNA casting, including the built-in gallery and major video apps
strings.ui_close_dialog_text: You can close only this window: playback pauses and the phone stays connected. The next phone action reopens the window and resumes playback.
strings.ui_picture_reset_desc: Restore all settings to their defaults.
strings.ui_settings_language_desc: The language used by the interface.
strings.ui_settings_theme_desc: The interface's light or dark appearance.
strings.ui_settings_accent_desc: The primary color of the interface.
strings.ui_settings_mica_desc: Uses colors from the Windows desktop wallpaper to give the window a distinctive look.
strings.ui_settings_accept_desc: Pause or resume receiving from the system tray.
strings.ui_settings_broadcast_desc: Periodically announces this device on the network. When off, it stops broadcasting, but your phone can still find this device by searching.
strings.ui_settings_interval_desc: Shorter intervals make this device easier to find but increase network traffic. If your phone cannot find this device, try a shorter interval.
strings.ui_about_device_name_desc: The device name shown on your phone.
strings.ui_about_device_address_desc: Control points (your phone) access this device at this address.
strings.ui_about_device_id_desc: Control points (your phone) use this ID to identify the device. It never changes once generated.
strings.ui_legal_intro: These notices ship with the program. They are not legal terms, but explanations of a few practical matters: how the program works, whether it uses the network, and how it relates to certain third parties.
